svg.title: Admin CCTP bridge to Arc testnet
svg.desc: Swimlane diagram showing how a TruMarket admin bridges USDC cross-chain onto Arc testnet using Circle's CCTP Bridge Kit from the buyer/supplier app.
svg.text: Admin CCTP bridge to Arc testnet
CCTP does NOT auto-fund DealVault or Lagoon pool per deal — this is a manual ops bridge step
used to maintain ops wallet balance on Arc for deal registry and settlement operations
